tools.name: find_loan_officers
tools.description: Use this when someone wants a US mortgage loan officer (or mortgage broker or lender contact) for a specific situation and place: for example an FHA, VA, USDA, jumbo, DSCR or ITIN loan, a first-time buyer, a self-employed borrower who needs a bank statement loan, a non-warrantable condo or a duplex,

tools.name: get_loan_officer
tools.description: Use this when you have a mortgage loan officer's individual NMLS ID and need their full profile. Returns LenDb's sourced record: name, title, current lender and branch, employment history, state licenses with license confidence, specialties (such as FHA, VA, bank statement or DSCR) with the evidence

tools.name: get_lender
tools.description: Use this when you need facts about a US mortgage lender, bank, credit union or mortgage broker company, by its company NMLS ID or by name (a partial name works). Returns the lender's type (bank, credit_union, imb, broker, other), headquarters state, website, the loan programs it offers (such as FHA,

tools.name: list_specialties
tools.description: Use this when you need the mortgage situations LenDb can match on. Returns every specialty with its slug, category (property type, loan program or borrower situation), label, one-line description and canonical_url: for example FHA, VA, USDA, jumbo, DSCR, bank statement, ITIN, self-employed, first-ti

tools.name: explain_specialty
tools.description: Use this when someone asks what a mortgage loan type or borrower situation means, such as a DSCR loan, a bank statement loan, an ITIN loan, a non-warrantable condo or an FHA loan. Returns, for one specialty slug, what it is, why it can be hard to get done, the questions a borrower should ask a loan

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_loan_officers, get_loan_officer · Private data: find_loan_officers, get_loan_officer, get_lender · Public sink: find_loan_officers, get_loan_officer.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_loan_officers, get_loan_officer · Private data: find_loan_officers, get_loan_officer, get_lender · Public sink: find_loan_officers, get_loan_officer

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

title: Tool description changed since last scan
detail: Tool "find_loan_officers" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Use this when someone wants a US mortgage loan officer (or mortgage broker or lender contact) for a specific situation and place: for example an FHA, VA, USDA, jumbo, DSCR or ITIN loan, a first-time buyer, a self-employed borrower who needs a bank statement loan, a non-warrantable condo or a duplex," → after: "Use this when someone wants a US mortgage loan officer (or mortgage broker or lender contact) for a specific situation and place: for example an FHA, VA, USDA, jumbo, DSCR or ITIN loan, a first-time buyer, a self-employed borrower who needs a bank statement loan, a non-warrantable condo or a duplex,"

remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
